annotation.bound_parties_text: The regulations bind persons operating remotely piloted aircraft systems, including pilots, crew members, visual observers, registered owners of remotely piloted aircraft, and owners of systems who must keep records.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: No pilot shall operate a remotely piloted aircraft system unless the registration number issued in accordance with section 901.05 is clearly visible on the remotely piloted aircraft.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Regulations Amending the Canadian Aviation Regulations (Remotely Piloted Aircraft Systems): SOR/2019-11
